FaqsComp.heading: Frequently Asked Questions – MSG91 Hello India

faqs.question: What is customer support software, and why do businesses need it?
faqs.answer:
• Customer support software is a tool that helps businesses receive, organise, track and solve customer queries from one place. Instead of handling messages across many apps, your team works from one shared inbox with tickets, AI chatbots, automation and reports.
  • Without customer support software, messages get lost across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, email, website chat, SMS, and phone calls. Customers wait longer, agents answer the same questions again and again, and managers can't see what's pending or who owns each request.
  • MSG91 Hello is AI-powered customer support software built to fix this. It brings WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, email, website live chat, SMS, RCS, Apple Messages for Business, X (Twitter) and voice calls into one shared inbox.
  • Every message becomes a ticket, so nothing gets missed. MSG91's AI chatbot and AI voice bot answer common questions 24/7 in many languages, while agents handle transferred issues with the full customer history in front of them.
  • With unlimited agents at no extra cost, MSG91 Hello helps businesses of every size reply faster, cut support costs and keep customers happy.

faqs.question: What is MSG91 Hello, and how does it work?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello is an AI-powered customer support platform and helpdesk software. It combines an omnichannel shared inbox, AI chatbots, AI voice bots, ticket management, cloud calling with IVR, workflow automation, multilingual translation, video calls with screen sharing, and analytics with CSAT reports, all in one place.
  • Here's how it works:
    • Connect your channels: Add WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, email, website live chat, SMS, RCS, Apple Messages for Business, X (Twitter) and voice calls, with no coding.
    • Add your team: Add unlimited agents, create teams and set roles and permissions.
    • Build your AI chatbot: Create it in minutes with a simple prompt, then add rule-based steps and API actions if needed.
    • Automate routing: Set workflows that send each ticket to the right agent, team or AI chatbot.
    • Track and improve: Use the analytics dashboard and CSAT reports to improve service.
  • The AI chatbot solves common queries instantly, and complex chats go to agents with full context. MSG91 is trusted by 30,000+ businesses across 192+ countries, with 200+ reviews on its G2 product profiles.

  • MSG91's AI chatbot replies on all your connected channels 24/7, and your team can manage everything from desktop or the free Hello mobile app for Android and iOS.

faqs.question: Can MSG91 Hello combine rule-based flow and AI in a single chatbot?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 Hello lets you build one smart chatbot that uses both rule-based steps and agentic AI in the same conversation. Most chatbot tools make you choose between a fixed-flow bot and an AI bot. MSG91 gives you both in one.
  • Use rule-based steps where you need fixed answers, like collecting a phone number, order ID or choice of service. Let the AI handle everything else. It understands questions in natural language, replies in many languages and answers follow-up questions like a human would.
  • For example: A customer taps Track Order and enters their order number in a fixed step. The bot makes an API call to fetch the live delivery status. When the customer asks, Why is it late, and can I change the address?, the AI explains the delay in simple words and helps with the next step.
  • MSG91's AI chatbot also offers:
    • 2,000+ app integrations and live API calls
    • Image and video analysis of what customers send
    • Multiple AI models with backup models, so replies never stop
    • Smooth handover to a human agent when the customer asks
    • No-code setup in minutes with a simple prompt
  • It works across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, website live chat and other connected channels, 24/7.

faqs.question: What is MSG91 Chat Window, and how does it reduce WhatsApp customer support costs?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Chat Window lets a customer start a conversation on WhatsApp and continue it in a separate chat window, without losing any context. The chat stays linked to the same WhatsApp ticket in MSG91 Hello.
  • Meta charges businesses for WhatsApp messages. Long support conversations, like refunds, product questions or troubleshooting, can mean many paid messages. Messages sent inside MSG91 Chat Window carry no Meta WhatsApp per-message charges. Only messages actually sent on WhatsApp follow Meta's pricing.
  • How it works:
    • The customer starts the chat on WhatsApp, the app they already use.
    • The conversation moves to MSG91 Chat Window with the full history.
    • The AI chatbot and agents reply from MSG91 Hello as usual.
    • The chat stays linked to the original WhatsApp ticket.
  • Chat Window supports text chat, plus supported calling and voice help in the same conversation. You keep WhatsApp as the easy first touchpoint and cut the cost of all the back-and-forth that follows.
  • Learn more in the MSG91 Chat Window guide.

    • Co-browsing and screen sharing: Agents can fix issues on the customer's screen, with permission.

faqs.question: What is MSG91 Hello pricing in India? Is there a free plan?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 Hello has two free plans and two paid monthly plans. Every plan includes unlimited agents and teams, with no per-agent fees.
    • Live Chat – ₹0/month: 1 inbox and unlimited live-chat tickets. Best for businesses that want a free website chat widget.
    • Free – ₹0/month: 2 inboxes and 50 tickets a month. Best for trying MSG91 Hello with your team.
    • Basic – ₹1,500/month: 2 inboxes, 1,000 tickets a month and a ₹1,500 bot wallet for AI chatbot usage. Best for small and growing support teams.
    • Premium – ₹3,000/month: 3 inboxes, 2,000 tickets a month and a ₹3,000 bot wallet. Best for busy teams handling more channels.
  • Each inbox can be a channel like WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, email, website live chat, SMS, RCS, Apple Messages for Business or X (Twitter).
  • Annual plans are also available. All prices exclude 18% GST. Because MSG91 Hello doesn't charge per agent, it costs far less than tools that charge for every user as your team grows. Start free today and upgrade when you need more inboxes or tickets.
  • Explore Pricing

faqs.question: Are there extra charges for agents, tickets, inboxes or AI bots?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello never charges for agents. Every plan, including the free plans, comes with unlimited agents and teams. Whether you have 5 agents or 500, you pay nothing extra for them.
  • On paid monthly plans, you only pay for what you use beyond your plan:
    • Extra inbox: ₹500 per inbox. Add more channels like WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, email, website live chat, SMS, RCS, Apple Messages for Business or X (Twitter).
    • Extra tickets: ₹0.50 per ticket on Basic and ₹0.75 per ticket on Premium, once you cross your monthly ticket limit.
    • AI bot usage: Deducted from your bot wallet as per the rate card. When the wallet runs out, you simply top it up.
  • On the Free plan, upgrade to a paid plan to get more inboxes, tickets or AI bot usage.
  • There are no hidden fees and no per-seat licence costs. You only pay for real usage.
